newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat mostly firmer on dry weather.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat mostly firmer on dry weather.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended mostly firmer as the weather reasserted itself as the major factor in this market, traders said.
With dry weather back, buyers started to look at weather again and shipper buying at the close also helped the new crop, one trader said.
Short covering by the shippers helped old crop months too, he said. But movement on the old crop was limited, and front month May, last traded 0.10 stg lower at 93.15 stg on volume of just 28 lots.
May was the only month to end lower and July last traded 0.30 stg higher at 96.00 stg.
The most active month was January, which last traded 1.00 stg higher at 98.50 stg. Of a total 748 lots, 257 were on January.
Barley ended higher, with active November last traded 0.75 stg up at 93.00 stg on volume of 34 lots of a total of 48 lots.
